references.text: The prophet Isaiah predicts the healing of the blind and deaf as a sign of the Messiah's coming, which is reflected in Jesus' actions.
The book of Psalms speaks of God's ability to open the eyes of the blind, which is reflected in Jesus' miracle.
Another event in Matthew where Jesus heals a deaf-mute demon-possessed man demonstrates Jesus' power over demons and disease.
Jesus refers to the healing of the blind and deaf as proof of His messianic mission, consistent with the event in Matthew 12:22.
Jesus mentions the healing of the blind and deaf as a sign of His messianic work, parallel to the event in Matthew 12:22.
